title: Mind Machines

publisher.name: Redfoxpress
publisher.location: Dugort, Achill Island, County Mayo, Ireland

description.main: A collage artist's book by the German analogue collage artist Sabine Remy, issued as volume 140 in Redfoxpress's "C'est mon Dada" series. The 40-page hardcover pairs vintage mechanical diagrams with salvaged paper and typography.
description.extended:
Vintage mechanical imagery collides with hand-cut typography in Mind Machines, the German collage artist Sabine Remy's entry in Redfoxpress's C'est mon Dada series, its cover built around blueprint-style renderings of viewing apparatuses under a hand-lettered title.

Issued in January 2020 as volume 140, the 40-page hardcover follows the series' standard A6 format (10.5 × 15 cm), thread-and-quarter-cloth bound and laser-printed on ivory paper. Remy assembles her collages from salvaged books and printed ephemera dating largely from the 1950s and earlier, pairing technical diagrams with fragments of vintage advertising and instructional graphics.

Remy is a German analogue collage artist who has kept the blog Miriskum.de since 2012, posting over a thousand works and building an international network of collaborators. She favors old paper "because they are often a little bizarre ... full of lived life," summarizing her method as "I cut, therefore I am." Her work has appeared in Collage – Contemporary European Perspectives at the Neue Sächsische Galerie, Chemnitz, and the Retroavangarda anthology Modern Collage.
description.artist_bio: Sabine Remy is a German analogue collage artist who works mainly with old books and vintage paper material, often from the 1950s and earlier. She has maintained her collage blog, Miriskum.de, since 2012, with over a thousand posts, and is active in international mail-art and assembling-magazine networks. Her work has been included in group exhibitions such as Collage - Contemporary European Perspectives at the Neue Sachsische Galerie, Chemnitz, the Retroavangarda 10th-anniversary anthology Modern Collage (Warsaw), and World Collage Day events.
